sections.heading: The 3 Biggest Tech Interview Bottlenecks — Solved by AI
sections.text: Most developers fail interviews not because they can't code, but because they can't explain their projects or their resumes never get seen.

cards.title: Resume Getting Rejected?
cards.problem: Over 75% of developer resumes are automatically filtered out by Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) before a human recruiter or engineering manager ever reads them.
cards.solution: The AI audits your resume against target tech job descriptions, identifies missing keywords, refines impact metrics, and ensures your resume easily scores 95%+ in ATS evaluations.

cards.title: Can't Explain Your Projects?
cards.problem: Interviewers grill you on architectural tradeoffs, database indexes, API bottlenecks, and edge cases in your projects. Reciting memorized answers immediately raises red flags.
cards.solution: Upload your code or GitHub repository. The AI reads your actual codebase and generates specific, challenging technical questions tailored to your implementation decisions.

cards.title: Blanking In Technical Rounds?
cards.problem: Freezing up or stumbling over live coding, system design, or unexpected deep-dive questions under the scrutiny of senior interviewers.
cards.solution: Practice realistic voice and text mock simulations that mirror FAANG and top product company hiring rounds, providing adaptive hints, rubrics, and instant confidence-building feedback.

faqs.q: How does the AI generate questions specifically from my code?
faqs.a: Unlike generic question lists, the InterviewPrep AI parser analyzes your GitHub repositories and source files. It examines your schema definitions, API endpoints, state management, dependencies, and component structure to simulate the exact technical grillings that senior interviewers perform during portfolio reviews.

faqs.q: Is there any charge or credit card required to start?
faqs.a: No credit card is required to begin practicing. You can immediately launch the AI interview simulator, test your resume for ATS compliance, and participate in baseline mock rounds for free at interview-prep.app.

faqs.q: Can this tool help me pass automated ATS resume screenings?
faqs.a: Yes. The AI incorporates ATS-benchmarked algorithms that scan your resume against live industry job descriptions. It identifies missing tech keywords, poorly quantified accomplishments, and formatting pitfalls that often cause resumes to be discarded before human review.

faqs.q: How does this platform complement techcadd Lucknow's offline classroom training?
faqs.a: At techcadd Lucknow, students work on live client projects and receive in-person mentorship. Integrating InterviewPrep AI allows learners to practice continuous mock interviews anytime at home, sharpening their impromptu communication and technical articulation between classroom review sessions.

faqs.q: Which roles and domains are supported?
faqs.a: The tool supports Full Stack Developers (MERN, MEAN, Java, Python), Frontend Engineers, Backend Architects, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Cloud/DevOps Practitioners, and Cyber Security specialists from fresher level to senior engineering roles.
